transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:

transcript.text:

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Got it. When exactly did you first notice this blurriness after your surgery?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And do you think the blurriness is getting better, getting worse, or staying about the same?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I see. And would you describe your vision as slightly hazy, or is it more completely blurred?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Thank you for that detail.

transcript.text: I'm experiencing the haziness even without my old glasses.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Okay, thank you for that information.

transcript.speaker: patient
